summary: The Acer Nitro 16 gaming system state baseline is characterized by smooth performance in games and applications at high resolutions, reliable cooling system to prevent thermal throttling, fast storage performance with NVMe SSD, good display quality with IPS panel and 144Hz refresh rate.
detected_fault: Thermal Throttling due to inadequate cooling system design or insufficient heat dissipation mechanisms.
suggested_solution: Upgrade the cooling system by replacing the existing fans with more efficient ones or adding additional heat sinks to improve airflow and heat dissipation.
